newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge higher, fueled by banks.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge higher, fueled by banks.

text.p: Tokyo stocks edged higher in Tuesday's morning session, as buying in bank and blue-chip shares fueled the rise started by a rebound in the Dow industrials overnight, brokers said. They said that short covering constituted most of the activity.
As of 0116 GMT, the Nikkei average was 276.23 points or 1.56 percent higher at 17,968.70. Its June futures were 330 points higher at 17,970.
"Profit-taking pressure is fairly strong at the 18,000 threshold and whether or not it can stay above it remains to be seen," a strategist at a second-tier brokerage said.
